text:
Dylan Brooks: Heads up from this morning’s demo dry run: Console empty states are making the demo *really* awkward. We land in Usage, graphs are empty, and we have to explain “oh you need to pick the right project + time range” while everyone stares at blank charts.

Markus Klein: +1. This is the exact moment the room goes quiet. Even when synthetic traffic is running, default time range/project selection seems to miss it. We end up clicking around for ~60s.

Chloe Martin: Which view specifically? Usage overview? Route latency? Costs?

Markus Klein: Mainly:
- Console → Usage (token cost + latency)
- Console → Requests/errors
Empty state is “No data” but doesn’t tell you what to do. Also default time range looks like “Last 15m” and demo traffic is sparse sometimes.

Mei Lin: Demo seed job is writing events to the `demo-synthetic` project in the Demo org. If Console lands you in another project (or no project), you’ll see zeros.

Dylan Brooks: Exactly. Ask from field: small UX tweak so demo doesn’t start with a blank page.
Ideas:
1) If org has a “recommended” project (we can tag demo project), default select it on Console entry
2) Default time range to Last 24h (or at least 1h) for the Overview dashboards
3) Improve empty state copy: “No usage yet for this time range/project. Try selecting a different time range or run synthetic traffic.”

Allison Grant: From SRE/alerts side: we already have a “dashboard freshness” check planned. But UI-side, a better empty state would reduce support pings.

Chloe Martin: We can probably do (2) quickly. Default time range is currently 15m in a couple places for perf reasons.
If we make it “Last 1h” as default + add a one-click “Last 24h” chip, does that solve most of it?

Markus Klein: 1h would already be a big improvement. 15m is brutal for demos.
Also the empty state should explicitly call out “check selected project” — half the time that’s the culprit.

Soojin Lee: +1 on copy. For live demos we need the product to guide the story, not force the presenter to explain product quirks.
Even something like: “No data yet. Make a test request or run the demo traffic generator.” would be perfect.

Mei Lin: On the “run traffic generator” CTA: we can expose a link to the internal runbook/command for demo org only. Otherwise we have to be careful not to suggest customers need a cron job to see dashboards.

Dylan Brooks: Yep, for non-demo orgs we keep it generic (“Make a request to populate usage”). For demo org we can show the internal hint behind the `is_demo_tenant` flag.

Chloe Martin: OK, let’s track as a small Console UX fix + guardrails.
I’ll file a Linear ticket and loop design for copy suggestions.

Chloe Martin: Linear: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4928/console-improve-empty-state-and-default-time-range-for-demo
Scope proposal:
- Default dashboard time range from 15m → 1h on Usage + Requests
- Empty state copy mentions project/time range selection
- Optional: if `org.is_demo_tenant`, add subtle banner “This is a demo tenant — make a request to see metrics” (no customer-facing mention of traffic generator)

Elliot Price: If/when that lands, I’ll update the internal demo guide + run-of-show to remove the “click time range to 24h” step.

Allison Grant: Please add acceptance criteria: opening Console to Usage should show non-empty graphs within 30s *assuming seed traffic job is healthy*. Otherwise we keep getting “Console is broken” reports.

Markus Klein: Thanks. This will save us real time. Also note: the empty state right now shows “No data in selected period” but doesn’t show what period is selected unless you open the picker. That’s part of the confusion.

Chloe Martin: Good call — we can show the selected range in the header (e.g., “Last 1h”) as plain text even before opening picker.

Dylan Brooks: :thumbsup: Appreciate it. This is one of those “tiny fix, huge demo impact” things.
